name: Skybreaker Blade
description: A heavy straight sword of grey meteor-iron. Storm-quenched, fuller inlaid with a running line of silver that flickers when the wielder's pulse quickens. When it strikes true, the air itself briefly forgets which way to fall.

name: Stormcloud Sash
description: A wide grey sash stitched with woven storm-crow feathers. Blows that would shatter ribs drop a hand's span short, as if the cloth were remembering being weather.

name: Broken Terrace Medallion
description: A half-disc of jade, broken cleanly along a line of old qi. The Jadestep crest — crane over peak — survives on one half; the other belongs to a cultivator four hundred years dead. Warm in the palm.

name: Storm-Warded Talisman
description: A slim bronze plaque inscribed with the eight-character Stormwarden ward. The etching still smells faintly of ozone; the charm hums in the pocket when lightning is close.

name: Thundergold Pill
description: A gold-brown pill veined with hair-thin silver lines. It tastes like copper and summer. Floods the meridians with a sudden, jagged tide of qi.

name: Ironbark Pill
description: A dense dark-brown pill pressed from ironbark resin and crushed ape-knucklebone. Hardens the skin and the will together. Permanent +1 DEF.

name: Sky-Qi Crystal
description: A shard of crystal that was never cut — only grown in the high air. It is cold to the touch and faintly luminous; holding it is like breathing at twice the altitude.

name: Cloudroot Spirit Stone
description: A fist-sized chunk of qi-dense stone the colour of stormlight. Heavier than it looks; every cultivator in every sect would take one as payment without bargaining.

name: Storm-Crow Feather
description: A long slate-and-silver feather. It does not lie flat — the quill remembers wind and the wind remembers back.

name: Cloudstep Ape Knucklebone
description: A dense white bone, warm in the hand. Alchemists pay for it; forge-masters pay more.

name: Jadestep Sword-Shard
description: A broken fragment of a revenant's spirit-blade. It cuts nothing; it only remembers having cut. Collectors of old-sect relics pay handsomely.

name: Gale Tiger Fang
description: A long curved fang still cold with stolen wind. It is the only part of the beast that did not dissolve into cloud. Patriarch Mingshu asked for it by name.

name: Heart-Devouring Hide
description: A dense grey pelt still exhaling a thin, cold mist. Sect forge-masters can stitch it into robes that laugh at bladework.

name: Heart-Devouring Robe
description: A long grey robe stitched from the pelt of the Heart-Devouring Gale Tiger, seams cured with jadestep-shard dust. The cloth drinks the cold out of the air around the wearer; the shoulders never bear snow. Blades striking it slide a fraction too far to the left, as if remembering that the hide had teeth once.

name: Cloudstep Charm
description: A short string of cloudstep-ape knucklebones bound between three storm-crow quills. Knotted by a novice of the Azure Cloud Forge and blessed, in passing, by whoever happened to be in the room. It rattles faintly when the wearer moves, which Forge-Master Bo insists is the charm reminding the bones that they are a weapon.
